item.title: XRP Surges 16% as Ripple Boosts RLUSD Stablecoin Activity
item.summary: XRP climbed about 16% to $1.39 as activity surrounding Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin increased, drawing renewed attention to the relationship between stablecoin operations and the XRP market. The move comes as traders monitor on-chain activity for indications of changing demand, liquidity and investor sentiment across the XRP Ledger ecosystem. Ripple issued 900,000 RLUSD tokens on Aug.
